Kimberly —

Thanks, updating now. High-level summary for the matrix:
- Top infra risks (proposed):
  1) NVMe degradation under sustained KV-cache load — mitigations: throttle small sessions, enable rolling cache compaction; contingency: short-term capacity bump (2 GPUs) — ETA: 48 hours to provision.
  2) Model cold-start latency variability (quantized variants) — mitigations: warm standby for critical routes; contingency: revert to float32 variant for enterprise tier — ETA: 4 hours to flip routing.
  3) Canary dataset regression spike under new tokenizer changes — mitigations: patch tokenizer mapping; contingency: rollback tokenizer commit — ETA: <2 hours.

I'll attach the perf snapshots and a short note on how the heatmap numbers map to recent production incidents. See attached perf_benchmarks_v2.pdf. I'll trim the long list down and add 1-line mitigation / ETA items in the doc.

Attachments: perf_benchmarks_v2.pdf (application/pdf)
